objs.name: document
objs.description: A managed information object (policy, guideline, procedural instruction, work instruction, etc.) that goes through creation, editing, release, distribution, versioning, and archiving.

attributes.name: document_type
attributes.description: Classification level/type of the document (e.g. policy, guideline, procedural instruction, work instruction).

attributes.name: title
attributes.description: The descriptive title of the document.

attributes.name: abbreviation
attributes.description: Type abbreviation prefix used in the document name (e.g. RL).

attributes.name: number
attributes.description: Cross-client consecutive 4-digit number per document type.

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status (e.g. editing, released, out of force, archived).

attributes.name: version
attributes.description: Current version number of the document.

attributes.name: valid_from
attributes.description: Date from which the released version is valid.

attributes.name: valid_until
attributes.description: Date until which the document remains valid, calculated from Valid From plus validity period.

attributes.name: archive_duration
attributes.description: Period the document is retained after invalidation before physical deletion.

attributes.name: language
attributes.description: Original language of the document.

attributes.name: references
attributes.description: Links to master data, IT applications, other documents, processes, organizational units, or risks.

attributes.name: relevant_companies
attributes.description: Companies or areas of validity for the document.

objs.name: attachment
objs.description: A controlled sub-document linked to a main document; subject to its own versioning and released together with the main document.

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the attachment.

attributes.name: version
attributes.description: Current version number of the attachment.

objs.name: additional_info
objs.description: A non-controlled supplement to a document that is not subject to the release cycle and can be published directly.

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: Published or unpublished status of the additional information.

objs.name: change_proposal
objs.description: A formal proposal to amend an existing released document, managed independently of the document version history.

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: Current status of the change proposal (e.g. created, scheduled, completed).

objs.name: validity_extension_request
objs.description: A system-generated request to check and extend the validity of a document approaching its expiry date.

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: Current status of the validity extension request.

objs.name: override_request
objs.description: A request to invalidate (put out of force) a released document and archive it.

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: Current status of the override request.

objs.name: reactivation_request
objs.description: A request to reactivate a previously invalidated/archived document.

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: Current status of the reactivation request.

objs.name: user
objs.description: An individual person who participates in document management processes in various roles.

attributes.name: name
attributes.description: Name of the user.

objs.name: user_group
objs.description: A named group of users used for assigning read/write authorizations and distribution lists.

attributes.name: group_name
attributes.description: Name of the user group (e.g. Reader, Author, Reviewer, Releaser, Archive, Business Admin).

objs.name: distribution_list
objs.description: A list of user groups and persons assigned to a document for notification or acknowledgement upon release.

attributes.name: distribution_type
attributes.description: Type of distribution: by e-mail or for acknowledgement.

objs.name: workflow
objs.description: An instance of a workflow process that guides approval, validity extension, override, reactivation, or acknowledgement tasks.

attributes.name: workflow_type
attributes.description: Type of workflow (release, validity extension, override, reactivation, translation release, acknowledgement).

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: Current status of the workflow instance.

evts.name: create_document
evts.description: A new document object is created in the system with selection of document type and optional template.

attributes.name: document_type
attributes.description: The type selected for the new document.

attributes.name: template
attributes.description: The template chosen for the new document, if any.

evts.name: edit_document_content
evts.description: The content of a document is edited using the integrated editing client.

evts.name: edit_document_properties
evts.description: Metadata and attributes of a document are maintained or changed via the properties dialog.

attributes.name: category
attributes.description: The metadata category being edited (e.g. Master data, Control).

evts.name: convert_to_pdf
evts.description: The document is automatically converted to PDF after saving.

evts.name: start_release_workflow
evts.description: The 3-step approval workflow (Creator-Review-Release) is initiated by the author or co-author.

evts.name: sign_creator_step
evts.description: The registered author signs the document in the first workflow step.

attributes.name: electronic_signature
attributes.description: Signature of the author.

evts.name: review_document
evts.description: A reviewer checks the document for technical and/or formal correctness.

attributes.name: review_result
attributes.description: Positive approval or rejection by the reviewer.

attributes.name: electronic_signature
attributes.description: Signature of the reviewer.

evts.name: release_document
evts.description: A releaser approves the document for publication.

attributes.name: release_result
attributes.description: Positive approval or rejection by the releaser.

attributes.name: electronic_signature
attributes.description: Signature of the releaser.

evts.name: reject_document
evts.description: A reviewer or releaser rejects the document during the approval workflow, canceling the workflow for subsequent participants.

attributes.name: rejection_reason
attributes.description: Reason provided for the rejection.

evts.name: publish_document
evts.description: After release, the document is automatically published and made visible to addressed readers.

evts.name: create_new_version
evts.description: A new editing version of a released document is created due to content changes, attribute changes, attachment changes, or scheduled change proposals.

attributes.name: trigger
attributes.description: Reason for version creation (content change, attribute change, attachment change, change proposal).

evts.name: create_attachment
evts.description: A new controlled attachment is added to a document, triggering a new version of the main document.

evts.name: modify_attachment
evts.description: An existing attachment is modified, triggering a new version of the main document.

evts.name: archive_attachment
evts.description: An attachment is marked for archiving; actual archiving occurs upon release of the next main document version.

evts.name: add_additional_info
evts.description: Additional information is added to a document without affecting its version or release cycle.

evts.name: delete_additional_info
evts.description: Additional information is removed from a document.

evts.name: create_change_proposal
evts.description: A change proposal is created for an existing released document.

evts.name: schedule_change_proposal
evts.description: A change proposal is scheduled for implementation, triggering creation of a new document version.

evts.name: complete_change_proposal
evts.description: The author documents completion of a change proposal; the proposal creator is notified.

evts.name: create_validity_extension_request
evts.description: The system automatically creates a validity extension request 30 days before the document's Valid Until date.

evts.name: process_validity_extension
evts.description: The validity extension request is processed through a workflow; validity is extended or revision/override is initiated.

attributes.name: decision
attributes.description: Extend validity, revise document, or initiate override.

evts.name: extend_validity
evts.description: The document validity is confirmed and the Valid Until date is updated by the default period.

attributes.name: new_valid_until
attributes.description: Updated Valid Until date after extension.

evts.name: create_override_request
evts.description: A user with write access creates a request to invalidate a document.

evts.name: process_override
evts.description: The override request is processed through a workflow with review and release steps.

attributes.name: override_result
attributes.description: Approval or rejection of the override.

attributes.name: electronic_signature
attributes.description: Signature of the processing participant.

evts.name: declare_out_of_force
evts.description: The document is officially invalidated; its status is set to Out of Force and all rights except archive group are revoked.

evts.name: physical_deletion
evts.description: An archived document is physically deleted after the archive duration has expired.

evts.name: create_reactivation_request
evts.description: A Business Admin group member creates a request to reactivate an invalidated document.

evts.name: process_reactivation
evts.description: The reactivation request is confirmed, creating a new version of the archived document with restored metadata and authorizations.

evts.name: assign_authorization
evts.description: Read or write authorizations are assigned to user groups or individual persons for a document.

attributes.name: authorization_type
attributes.description: Type of authorization (read, write).

evts.name: maintain_distribution_list
evts.description: User groups or persons are assigned to the distribution list of a document for email or acknowledgement distribution.

attributes.name: distribution_type
attributes.description: Email distribution or acknowledgement distribution.

evts.name: send_distribution_email
evts.description: Email notifications are sent to users on the distribution list upon release of a new document version.

evts.name: request_acknowledgement
evts.description: Users on the acknowledgement distribution list are requested by email to confirm they have read the document.

evts.name: confirm_acknowledgement
evts.description: A user confirms acknowledgement of a released document version via the workflow task.

evts.name: translate_document
evts.description: Released document content is translated into another language.

attributes.name: target_language
attributes.description: The language into which the document is translated.

evts.name: review_translation
evts.description: A translated document version is reviewed for correctness.

attributes.name: review_result
attributes.description: Positive approval or rejection.

attributes.name: electronic_signature
attributes.description: Signature of the translation reviewer.

evts.name: release_translation
evts.description: A translated document version is approved and released, making it visible to readers in the corresponding language.

attributes.name: electronic_signature
attributes.description: Signature of the translation releaser.
